title: DNS apps
subtitle: Extend the server's query pipeline: logging, blocking, rewriting and custom responses

installed.title: Installed apps
installed.emptyHint: Install from the app store, or upload a local ZIP package. Features such as query logs depend on the corresponding app.
installed.autoUpdateHint: The server periodically checks for and installs new versions. Adjust this under Settings → Updates.

dnsApps.title: DNS app list
dnsApps.hint: A single app package can register multiple DNS apps, each handling different queries.
dnsApps.name: App name
dnsApps.empty: This app has not registered any DNS apps

store.title: App store
store.subtitle: Provided by the official Technitium repository. Downloads and installs happen on the DNS server.
store.empty: No apps available in the store
store.emptyHint: The server may not be able to reach the app repository. Check its network and proxy settings.
store.loadFailed: Failed to load the store list
store.loadFailedHint: The app store is fetched by the DNS server itself, so reachability from this machine does not imply reachability from the server.
store.downloadHint: The DNS server downloads the package itself. Duration depends on the server's outbound connectivity.

install.localSubtitle: Upload an app package — suitable for offline environments or custom apps
install.nameHelp: Used as the app's unique identifier on the server. Must match the manifest inside the package.
install.fileDrop: Drop a .zip file here, or click to select
install.fileHint: Only ZIP packages in Technitium DNS app format are accepted.
install.noFile: Select a ZIP file to upload
install.fromStoreBody: The DNS server will download and install this app from the official repository.

update.localSubtitle: Upload an update package for the installed app {name}
update.fromStoreBody: Will update to version {version}. Queries handled by this app may fail briefly during the update.
update.updateAllConfirm: Every app with a new version available will be updated. Related queries may fail briefly during the process.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {name}
uninstall.body: Uninstall the app {name}? Every DNS app it registered will stop working, and any query logging that depends on it will stop recording.

config.title: Configure {name}
config.subtitle: Custom configuration for the app. The app is reloaded after saving.
config.rawHint: The configuration format is defined by the app itself. Most apps use JSON.
config.formatFailed: Cannot format: content is not valid JSON
config.invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Fix the errors before saving.
config.empty: This app has no editable configuration
config.resetHint: Reverts to the initial configuration shipped with the app.
config.discardConfirm: Discard the current changes and revert to the saved configuration?
config.loadFailedHint: This app may not support editing its configuration through the API.
config.jsonFieldHint: This field's value is JSON. Edit it as JSON.
